Introduction

Nebula is a fictional project girl group created for the upcoming web drama of the same name, "Nebula". It was announced during the group's press conference that they would be making their debut in December, with a sound inspired by J-Pop trends. However the drama itself has been postponed with no further updates on the show, nor the group, since late 2024.

According to the drama's plot, the group is a Korean-Japanese four members girl group consisting of Sera (played by T-ARA's Qri), Kokomi (portrayed by former IOI and PRISTIN's member Nayoung), Chaeyoung (played by soloist JinE), and Ria (portrayed by former POA and BOTOPASS' member Ria).
